ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$8.03 as a Ryde voucher (RD-2: unexempt detour 5.70 km × S$1.41/km); no account flag (driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0).

segment_findings.reason: Overshoot past the Jurong East exit mainline (gps 21:58:00–22:05:30, turning point ≈1.2905,103.7738 at 21:59:00) with the trace re-passing the same exit at 22:05:30; the intermediate points 1.2894,103.7766 / 1.2878,103.7787 lie off the quoted corridor, i.e. an out-and-back of ≈4 km plus residual spacing = ≈5.70 km added. No chat consent before the deviation (RD-5 fails; driver never asked). Not exempted by RD-4(a): the Ayer Rajah Expressway Accident was reported_at 21:57:50, i.e. after the trace had already left the route (last on-route 21:57:30) and after the driver had already passed the incident node at 21:55–21:56; error is systematic (a closing freeway exit is passed once, not by the same road twice). RD-4(b) band 5 is corroborative only. Counts under RD-1/RD-2.

Residual gap between the 5.70 km I attribute to seg1 and the measured 4.98 km overall excess (≈0.7 km) is within map-matching/traversal error rather than a second discrete detour; no separate off-route episode with chat or traffic evidence could be isolated. If treated as a segment it is undetermined, but its effect is immaterial to the S$8.03 computation (RD-2 refunds only distance units on unexempt segments).

rejected_claims.reason: RD-4 requires a LTA incident on the replaced optimal-route stretch reported_at BEFORE that segment began; here reported_at 21:57:50 postdates the driver's own passage of the incident node (21:55–21:56) and the point at which the trace left the quoted route (21:57:30), so the accident does not explain the earlier overshoot.
RD-2 compensates distance units on unexempt segments only (5.70 km × S$1.4098/km = S$8.03), not the entire 4.98 km/metre difference plus time fare, and map-matching residue ≤0.25 km is excluded.
No consent exists: the chat (21:37:20/21:37:50) is only a pickup arrangement and contains no route agreement; a driver's claim of verbal agreement is not consent (RD-5).
